signal: Olio raised an $11M Series B led by Fulcrum Equity Partners (2025) to expand its acute / post-acute care coordination platform and accelerate market expansion

email.body1:
Nathan, saw Olio closed its $11M Series B with Fulcrum to push product and market expansion across acute and post-acute care.

Scaling post-raise usually means more health systems and post-acute partners in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Olio off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nathan, quick follow-up for Olio.

Post-Series-B, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can, and most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap surfaces late, then it is a scramble to save the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Olio needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nathan, last bit of proof for Olio.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Olio's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage health-IT startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nathan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a health-IT growth motion? I will tailor it to Olio either way.
